journey.name: RegularSeasonQuizFlow
journey.description: Verifies a user can start a Regular Season game, answer a trivia question, and advance to the next round.

actions.action: Tap the 'Regular Season' button. Verify the trivia question screen appears showing a 'Score:' label and a 'Lives:' label.
Verify a hockey trivia question is displayed above several player answer buttons.
Tap the first player answer button. Verify that either 'Correct!' or 'Incorrect!' feedback text appears near the top of the screen.
Tap the 'Next' button. Verify a new trivia question is displayed.
